brief: A little tidy for spare 3D-printer nozzles and one hex key.

requirements.evidence: Single hex base (piece:0,0,0;full) fitted with hex-bin-third, a shallow third-depth open bin (floor depth 34 mm), set into the cell. End caps (capOpenFaces) and lockJoints applied; check_build ok, meshClash clear.
requirements.requirement: A little tidy (small open storage) for spare 3D-printer nozzles

requirements.evidence: Divided bins (div2/div3) were tried but their 44-69 mm-wide compartments refused the 153 mm hex key (PROP_NO_REST, overlaps cell wall), so the final build uses an undivided shallow bin whose 142 mm floor holds both. Staged with a small-parts heap (heap-screws-div3, prop:5) as a stand-in for the spare nozzles — the prop catalogue has no nozzle prop, so the nozzles themselves are represented, not modelled. The heap sits below the rim (PROP_BELOW_RIM warning noted) but is visible looking into the bin.
requirements.requirement: Spare nozzles kept visible/accessible rather than buried in a deep tray

requirements.evidence: hexkey-5 prop (prop:3, 5 mm ball-end hex key) rests in the same bin beside the small-parts heap after re-orienting it on its long edge; the configurator refused it in every divided compartment, so it shares the single open floor instead of a separate slot.
requirements.requirement: One hex key stored with the nozzles

finish.summary: A single-cell Hex Cluster base with a shallow (third-depth) open bin, end-capped and joint-locked. Divided bins were attempted first for separation, but their narrow compartments refused the 153 mm hex key, so the final tidy is one open shallow tray holding the hex key (prop:3) beside a small-parts heap (prop:5) standing in for the spare nozzles (the prop catalogue has no nozzle prop). House rules capOpenFaces and lockJoints were applied; check_build passes with meshClash clear. The only known shortcoming is that the small-parts heap sits below the bin rim and is best seen looking into the tray.

events.text: A small tidy for spare nozzles and a hex key — I'll find a compact bin layout that keeps them separated and visible.
